text: Water has a cold touch. It is of two kinds: eternal and non-eternal. The eternal is atomic in form; the non-eternal is the form of an effect. These are further of three kinds, according to the distinction of body, sense organ, and object. The body is in the realm of Varuna. The sense organ is the taste-grasper, the tongue, located at the tip of the tongue. The object is rivers, oceans, and so on. || 10 ||
